title: release-cutover-checklist-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-13
content:
Quick scratchpad for today's cutover (hotfix + minor rollout). Informal notes to self and action items.

Summary:
- Target: rollout service v1.4.2 (hotfix for tokenization crash).
- Owners: Olivia (cutover lead), Jordan (DB/backfill), Aisha (infra/monitoring).
- Window: 09:00-10:30 PT. Canary -> 50% -> 100% if healthy.

Timeline (rough):
- 08:00: final smoke + runback plan review with SRE (quick run-through).
- 08:30: push release notes draft to confluence + ops email.
- 08:45: confirm backports applied (ENG-4321 branch).
- 09:00: start canary (10% traffic) -> monitor 10m
- 09:15: if ok -> 50% -> monitor 15m
- 09:40: if ok -> 100% -> monitor 30m
- 10:15: post-cutover verifications + thumbs up email

Pre-cutover checks (must green):
- [ ] All CI green for release branch (checked at 08:00) -> note failing flaky test in PR#1287 but skipped for hotfix.
- [ ] Backports merged to release branch (Jordan) -> confirm commit hashes.
- [ ] DB migrations dry-runed in staging (no long locks).
- [ ] Alerting/SLIs pinned: tokenization/latency alerts muted for rollout window? (Aisha).
- [ ] Canary config ready (routing policy + fallback model variant).

Cutover steps (ops commands / high level):
- Push image tag: docker push ghcr.io/redwood/serving:v1.4.2-hotfix
- Update k8s deployment: kubectl set image deploy/serving server=... --record
- Trigger canary route change: /admin/route 10% -> 50% -> 100% via console API
- Wait/check: /metrics, error rates, 5xx spikes, tail-latency p95/p99

Backports / Code notes:
- ENG-4321 backport applied to release-1.4 (commit 7a3b2e). Verify no missing helper method from main.
- PR#1287 has small tweak; merged to release branch but left one TODO (non-blocking) documented in PR comment.
- If regression -> rollback by reverting release tag and restoring routing to previous deployment (kubectl rollout undo deploy/serving)

Post-cutover verification:
- Smoke endpoints: /health, /v1/generate quick prompts (3 models) -> expect <= 150ms median; no >1s tail errors.
- Run subset of synthetic prompts used in canary evaluation (script: infra/tools/canary-run.sh).
- Confirm no error spikes in Datadog dashboard "serving-main-errors" and Sentry for new exceptions.
- Ask support to spot-check customer queues for anomalies.

Comms (who to ping):
- Slack: #release-cutovers (announce start, canary->50, 50->100, done)
- Email ops@redwood.com for enterprise customers impacted by ~1h window (template in confluence).
- Pager duty oncall: SRE primary (Mateo), infra oncall Aisha, database: Jordan.

Rollback plan (quick):
- If error rate > 2% 5xx sustained for 5m OR latency p99 > 2s for 10m -> rollback.
- Steps: pause traffic -> kubectl rollout undo deploy/serving -> revert canary routes -> verify smoke -> send incident update.

Open items / TODOs (notes to self):
- [ ] Add small note in release notes about skipped flaky test and mitigation.
- [ ] Confirm KMS key access for private customers (ticket pending).
- [ ] Re-run perf microbench (sequence length 1024) after rollout to validate no regression.
- Check that canary metrics include per-model breakdown (not just aggregate).

Commands to remember (copy pasta):
- kubectl set image deploy/serving server=ghcr.io/redwood/serving:v1.4.2-hotfix -n production
- gh pr view 1287 --repo redwood/serving --json commits,files
- curl -sS -X POST "$CONSOLE_API/route" -d '{"service":"serving","weight":50}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"

Notes to self: keep comms short and concrete. If anything unexpected, call SRE first then notify product. Don't bury rollback under optimistic monitoring.

-- olivia
